header.move_type: URL restructure on the same domain: /resources moved to /blog, templates to /templates

scorecard.why: /resources/cancellation-policy-template (517 clicks, 14 referring domains) lands on the home page, and /resources/appointment-reminder-text-templates (642 clicks) lands on a page that answers 404. 4 template URLs take 2 hops and /resources uses a 302. The other 43 redirect in 1 permanent hop to the expected page.
The 10 pages outside the move with the most clicks (23,280 baseline clicks) still answer 200 with no redirect.

scorecard.key_number: 9 of 10 targets indexable; 1 canonical points elsewhere
scorecard.why: /blog/appointment-reminder-text-templates/ answers 404, so it can't be indexed (the same page as the broken redirect in area 1). /blog/deposit-policy/ still names its old URL /resources/deposit-policy as canonical; URL Inspection shows the same. Google has the other 6 inspected targets indexed as their own canonical.
Rules for * block only /app/, /account/, /api/; none of the new pages sits under them. The sitemap is declared.

scorecard.key_number: live sitemap: 74 URLs, 4 moved; Google re-read: yes; Bing re-read: no
scorecard.why: The live sitemap still lists 4 old category pages and lacks 1 expected target (/blog/appointment-reminder-text-templates/, the dead page). Google downloaded it on 2026-10-16, after the move. Bing last crawled it on 2026-10-09, before the move, and it's day 14.

scorecard.key_number: Google: 6 of 8 old URLs picked up; Bing: 1 of 4
scorecard.why: Google has recrawled 6 of the top 8 old URLs since the move, so more than half are picked up. Bing has recrawled 1 of 4; a URL submission for the working targets is offered below. Bing lists 1 crawl issue on a target: /blog/appointment-reminder-text-templates/ answers 404.

scorecard.key_number: moved pages -17.3% (469 to 388 clicks, 7 days vs 7 days)
scorecard.why: The moved URLs and their targets (home page left out) earned 388 clicks from 2026-10-15 to 2026-10-21 against 469 in the 7 days before the move: the targets gained 241 while the old URLs lost 322. 60 of the 81 lost clicks sit on the 2 failed redirects. Site clicks -1.9%. Before day 28 this can only warn.

scorecard.key_number: 231 404 views on a target path; GA4 capture ratio 0.83
scorecard.why: GA4 shows 231 'Page not found' views on /blog/appointment-reminder-text-templates/ since the move. Tracking is sound: GA4 recorded 0.83 Organic Search sessions per Search Console click over the baseline, and no day near the move jumped or fell.

act_now.issue: Template page with 14 referring domains redirects to the home page
act_now.evidence: 301 in 1 hop to / (expected /templates/cancellation-policy/, which answers 200 in the sitemap)
act_now.fix: Your exception sends it to /templates/cancellation-policy/, but the server sends it to the home page. Add the exception to the redirect rules above the catch-all.

act_now.issue: Old reminder-templates post redirects to a page that answers 404
act_now.evidence: 301 to /blog/appointment-reminder-text-templates/, which answers 404; GA4 counts 231 'Page not found' views there since the move and Bing lists it as a crawl issue
act_now.fix: The rule sends it to /blog/appointment-reminder-text-templates/, which answers 404. The post's new address in the live sitemap is /blog/appointment-reminder-templates/: add an exception pointing there.

watch.evidence: 301 to the target without the trailing slash, then 308 to add it
watch.fix: The template rule writes the target without the trailing slash, so a second redirect adds it. Add the slash to the rule's target.

watch.issue: The old hub page uses a temporary redirect
A moved post still names its old URL as canonical
watch.evidence: canonical-checker and URL Inspection user_canonical both give /resources/deposit-policy
watch.fix: Set the post's canonical to its own new URL (it was likely typed into the post's SEO field).

watch.issue: Old URLs in the sitemap, and Bing hasn't re-read it
watch.evidence: 4 /resources/category/ pages listed; Bing last crawled the sitemap 2026-10-09
watch.fix: Drop the old category pages from the sitemap generator, then resubmit it to Bing (offered below).

watch.issue: Moved pages are down while redirects settle
watch.evidence: 469 to 388 clicks (-17.3%); 60 of the 81 lost clicks are on the 2 failed redirects
watch.fix: Fix the two act-now redirects first; most of the loss sits there. Re-read on day 28.
